name: Collagen Silk Peptide Ampoule

detail.desc:
Ingredients

Hydrolyzed Collagen: Supplements collagen, boosts skin elasticity, and reduces deep wrinkles.
Peptide Complexes (Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4): Firms skin, smooths fine lines, improves dynamic wrinkles and sagging, and enhances anti-aging effects.
Sodium Hyaluronate: Deeply hydrates and locks in moisture, provides long-lasting hydration, and eases dryness.
Niacinamide + Adenosine: Brightens skin tone, improves dullness, and helps repair the skin barrier.
Plant Extracts like Centella Asiatica, Astragalus, and Scutellaria: Soothes and repairs, strengthens the barrier, and reduces sensitivity and redness.
Glycerin + Butylene Glycol: Moisturizes and nourishes, keeping skin soft and hydrated.

Effectiveness

Soften deep wrinkles and fine lines, tighten and lift the skin, and improve sagging.
Deeply hydrate and moisturize, relieve dryness, and make the skin soft and supple.
Brighten and even out skin tone, improve dullness, and boost skin radiance.
Repair and strengthen the skin barrier, soothe sensitivity, and enhance skin resilience.

Instructions

Remove the transparent cap from the top of the ampoule.
Insert the included syringe into the rubber stopper of the ampoule, tilt the ampoule, and take out the desired amount of serum.
Apply the serum to your face and gently massage until absorbed.
After use, put the syringe back into the ampoule and seal it for storage.
Store in a cool, dry place, avoiding high temperatures and direct sunlight.
